sentences.text: The documents do not state whether the 2% pre-payment charge clause complies with RBI’s current rules; the applicable current rule for this case is that, in cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
The sanction letter for the MSE business loan states: “2.2 Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid,” but the documents do not state the bank’s approved policy for this charge.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions are shown as superseded or no longer in force, including the 2025 Directions and the 2014 floating-rate term-loan rule.
